schema: CREATE TRIGGER audit_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON audit BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'The audit log is append-only'); END
CREATE TRIGGER audit_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON audit BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'The audit log is append-only'); END

CREATE TRIGGER credit_cancel_issued_only BEFORE INSERT ON credit_note_cancellations WHEN (SELECT status FROM credit_notes WHERE id=NEW.credit_note_id) IS NOT 'issued' BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Only an issued credit note can be cancelled'); END
CREATE TRIGGER credit_cancel_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON credit_note_cancellations BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Credit note cancellations are immutable'); END
CREATE TRIGGER credit_cancel_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON credit_note_cancellations BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Credit note cancellations are immutable'); END

CREATE TRIGGER credit_issue_needs_treatment BEFORE UPDATE OF status ON credit_notes WHEN NEW.status='issued' AND NEW.treatment IS NULL BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Credit treatment required before issuance'); END

CREATE TRIGGER credit_only_on_issued BEFORE INSERT ON credit_notes WHEN (SELECT status FROM invoices WHERE id=NEW.invoice_id)<>'issued' BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Credit notes require an issued invoice'); END

CREATE TRIGGER credit_ops_issued_only BEFORE INSERT ON credit_operations WHEN (SELECT status FROM credit_notes WHERE id=NEW.credit_note_id) IS NOT 'issued' BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Operations require an issued credit note'); END

CREATE TRIGGER credit_ops_match_treatment BEFORE INSERT ON credit_operations
    WHEN (NEW.kind LIKE 'refund%' AND (SELECT treatment FROM credit_notes WHERE id=NEW.credit_note_id) IS NOT 'remboursement')
      OR (NEW.kind LIKE 'offset%' AND (SELECT treatment FROM credit_notes WHERE id=NEW.credit_note_id) IS NOT 'compensation')
    BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Operation kind does not match the credit treatment'); END
CREATE TRIGGER credit_ops_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON credit_operations BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Credit operations are append-only'); END
CREATE TRIGGER credit_ops_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON credit_operations BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Credit operations are append-only'); END

CREATE TRIGGER credit_ops_not_cancelled BEFORE INSERT ON credit_operations WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM credit_note_cancellations WHERE credit_note_id=NEW.credit_note_id) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Cancelled credit note'); END

CREATE TRIGGER credit_ops_reversal_matches BEFORE INSERT ON credit_operations WHEN NEW.reverses_id IS NOT NULL AND
    (SELECT kind||'_reversal' FROM credit_operations WHERE id=NEW.reverses_id AND credit_note_id=NEW.credit_note_id AND amount=NEW.amount) IS NOT NEW.kind
    BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'A reversal must cancel one operation of the same note, kind and amount'); END

CREATE TRIGGER credit_ops_within_note BEFORE INSERT ON credit_operations WHEN NEW.kind IN ('refund','offset') AND
    COALESCE((SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN kind IN ('refund','offset') THEN amount ELSE -amount END) FROM credit_operations WHERE credit_note_id=NEW.credit_note_id),0)+NEW.amount >
    (SELECT (amount+COALESCE(other_amount,0))*(1+COALESCE(vat,0)/100.0)+0.05 FROM credit_notes WHERE id=NEW.credit_note_id)
    BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'The operations of a credit note cannot exceed its amount'); END
CREATE TRIGGER credit_snapshot_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON credit_note_snapshots BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Frozen credit notes cannot be deleted'); END
CREATE TRIGGER credit_snapshot_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON credit_note_snapshots BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Frozen credit notes are immutable'); END

CREATE TRIGGER credit_treatment_valid BEFORE INSERT ON credit_notes WHEN NEW.treatment IS NOT NULL AND NEW.treatment NOT IN ('remboursement','compensation') BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Unknown credit treatment'); END

CREATE TRIGGER credit_treatment_valid_upd BEFORE UPDATE OF treatment ON credit_notes WHEN NEW.treatment IS NOT NULL AND NEW.treatment NOT IN ('remboursement','compensation') BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Unknown credit treatment'); END
CREATE TRIGGER entry_changes_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON entry_changes BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Time entry history is append-only'); END
CREATE TRIGGER entry_changes_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON entry_changes BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Time entry history is append-only'); END

CREATE TRIGGER entry_delete_traced AFTER DELETE ON entries BEGIN INSERT INTO audit(event,detail) VALUES('entry_row_deleted',json_object('id',OLD.id,'invoiced',EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM invoice_annex_entries WHERE entry_id=OLD.id),'before',json_object('work_date',OLD.work_date,'project_id',OLD.project_id,'start_time',OLD.start_time,'end_time',OLD.end_time,'hours',OLD.hours,'description',OLD.description))); END

CREATE TRIGGER entry_id_never_reused BEFORE INSERT ON entries WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM entry_changes WHERE entry_id=NEW.id) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM invoice_annex_entries WHERE entry_id=NEW.id) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM import_batch_rows WHERE entry_id=NEW.id) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'An entry id that ever existed is never given again'); END

CREATE TRIGGER entry_update_traced AFTER UPDATE ON entries BEGIN INSERT INTO audit(event,detail) VALUES('entry_row_updated',json_object('id',OLD.id,'invoiced',EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM invoice_annex_entries WHERE entry_id=OLD.id),'before',json_object('work_date',OLD.work_date,'project_id',OLD.project_id,'start_time',OLD.start_time,'end_time',OLD.end_time,'hours',OLD.hours,'description',OLD.description),'after',json_object('work_date',NEW.work_date,'project_id',NEW.project_id,'start_time',NEW.start_time,'end_time',NEW.end_time,'hours',NEW.hours,'description',NEW.description))); END
CREATE TRIGGER historical_invoices_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON historical_invoices BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Historical invoices are never deleted (reject them instead)'); END

CREATE TRIGGER historical_invoices_source_values BEFORE UPDATE ON historical_invoices WHEN OLD.id IS NOT NEW.id OR OLD.project_id IS NOT NEW.project_id
    OR OLD.source_file IS NOT NEW.source_file OR OLD.source_sha256 IS NOT NEW.source_sha256 OR OLD.source_sheet IS NOT NEW.source_sheet OR OLD.source_cell IS NOT NEW.source_cell
    OR OLD.source_column IS NOT NEW.source_column OR OLD.invoice_date IS NOT NEW.invoice_date OR OLD.invoice_ref IS NOT NEW.invoice_ref OR OLD.qty_days IS NOT NEW.qty_days
    OR OLD.amount_ht IS NOT NEW.amount_ht OR OLD.unit_rate IS NOT NEW.unit_rate OR OLD.basis IS NOT NEW.basis OR OLD.qty_derived IS NOT NEW.qty_derived OR OLD.created_at IS NOT NEW.created_at
    BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'A historical invoice keeps the values read from its source; only its status can change'); END
CREATE TRIGGER invoice_annex_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON invoice_annex_entries BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Frozen invoice annex cannot be deleted'); END
CREATE TRIGGER invoice_annex_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON invoice_annex_entries BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Frozen invoice annex is immutable'); END

CREATE TRIGGER invoice_date_changes_draft_only BEFORE INSERT ON invoice_date_changes WHEN (SELECT status FROM invoices WHERE id=NEW.invoice_id)='issued'
    BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'The date of an issued invoice cannot change'); END
CREATE TRIGGER invoice_date_changes_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON invoice_date_changes BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Invoice date history is append-only'); END
CREATE TRIGGER invoice_date_changes_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON invoice_date_changes BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Invoice date history is append-only'); END

CREATE TRIGGER invoice_issue_needs_issued_at BEFORE UPDATE OF status ON invoices
    WHEN OLD.status='draft' AND NEW.status='issued' AND (NEW.issued_at IS NULL OR NEW.issued_at='')
    BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'An issued invoice needs its real issuance timestamp'); END

CREATE TRIGGER invoice_issue_needs_number BEFORE UPDATE OF status ON invoices WHEN NEW.status='issued' AND OLD.status='draft' AND (NEW.number IS NULL OR trim(NEW.number)='')
    BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'An issued invoice needs a number'); END

CREATE TRIGGER invoice_issued_at_only_at_issue BEFORE UPDATE OF issued_at ON invoices
    WHEN OLD.status='draft' AND NEW.issued_at IS NOT NULL AND NEW.status IS NOT 'issued'
    BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'issued_at is set only when the invoice is issued'); END

CREATE TRIGGER invoice_lines_no_delete_issued BEFORE DELETE ON invoice_lines WHEN (SELECT status FROM invoices WHERE id=OLD.invoice_id)='issued' BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Lines of an issued invoice cannot be deleted'); END

CREATE TRIGGER invoice_lines_no_insert_frozen BEFORE INSERT ON invoice_lines WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM invoice_snapshots WHERE invoice_id=NEW.invoice_id) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Lines of an issued invoice are immutable'); END

CREATE TRIGGER invoice_lines_no_update_issued BEFORE UPDATE ON invoice_lines WHEN (SELECT status FROM invoices WHERE id=OLD.invoice_id)='issued' BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Lines of an issued invoice are immutable'); END
CREATE TRIGGER invoice_number_changes_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON invoice_number_changes BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Invoice number history is append-only'); END
CREATE TRIGGER invoice_number_changes_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON invoice_number_changes BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Invoice number history is append-only'); END

CREATE TRIGGER invoice_number_not_historical_ins BEFORE INSERT ON invoices WHEN NEW.number IS NOT NULL AND NEW.status='draft'
    AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM historical_invoices WHERE upper(trim(invoice_ref))=upper(trim(NEW.number)))
    BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Invoice number already used by a historical invoice'); END

CREATE TRIGGER invoice_number_not_historical_upd BEFORE UPDATE OF number,status ON invoices WHEN NEW.number IS NOT NULL AND OLD.status='draft'
    AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM historical_invoices WHERE upper(trim(invoice_ref))=upper(trim(NEW.number)))
    BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Invoice number already used by a historical invoice'); END
CREATE TRIGGER invoice_snapshot_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON invoice_snapshots BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Frozen invoice snapshots cannot be deleted'); END
CREATE TRIGGER invoice_snapshot_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON invoice_snapshots BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Frozen invoice snapshots are immutable'); END
CREATE TRIGGER issued_credit_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON credit_notes WHEN OLD.status='issued' BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Issued credit notes cannot be deleted'); END
CREATE TRIGGER issued_credit_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON credit_notes WHEN OLD.status='issued' BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Issued credit notes are immutable'); END
CREATE TRIGGER issued_invoice_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON invoices WHEN OLD.status='issued' BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Issued invoices cannot be deleted'); END
CREATE TRIGGER issued_invoice_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON invoices WHEN OLD.status='issued' BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Issued invoices are immutable'); END

CREATE TRIGGER variance_decisions_issued_note BEFORE INSERT ON invoice_variance_decisions WHEN NEW.credit_note_id IS NOT NULL AND
    (SELECT status FROM credit_notes WHERE id=NEW.credit_note_id AND invoice_id=NEW.invoice_id) IS NOT 'issued'
    BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'A credit note decision needs an issued credit note of the same invoice'); END

CREATE TRIGGER variance_decisions_issued_only BEFORE INSERT ON invoice_variance_decisions WHEN (SELECT status FROM invoices WHERE id=NEW.invoice_id) IS NOT 'issued'
    BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'A variance decision concerns an issued invoice'); END
CREATE TRIGGER variance_decisions_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON invoice_variance_decisions BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Variance decisions are append-only'); END
CREATE TRIGGER variance_decisions_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON invoice_variance_decisions BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Variance decisions are append-only'); END
CREATE TABLE audit(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,event TEXT NOT NULL,detail TEXT NOT NULL,created_at TEXT DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)

CREATE TABLE billing_addresses(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, client_key TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(client_key)>0),
  label TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(trim(label))>0), contact TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', address TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(trim(address))>0),
  active INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK(active IN (0,1)), sort_order INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, created_at TEXT NOT NULL, updated_at TEXT, UNIQUE(client_key,label))

CREATE TABLE credit_note_cancellations(credit_note_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES credit_notes(id), reference TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    reason TEXT NOT NULL, issued_at TEXT NOT NULL, header_json TEXT NOT NULL, pdf BLOB NOT NULL, pdf_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE credit_note_snapshots(credit_note_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES credit_notes(id), reference TEXT NOT NULL, frozen_at TEXT NOT NULL, header_json TEXT NOT NULL, pdf BLOB NOT NULL, pdf_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE credit_notes(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, reference TEXT UNIQUE, invoice_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES invoices(id), amount REAL NOT NULL, reason TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TEXT DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft', issued_at TEXT, qty REAL, unit_rate REAL, vat REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, description TEXT DEFAULT '', treatment TEXT, tva_amount REAL, other_amount REAL DEFAULT 0, other_vat_mode TEXT, refund_delay_days INTEGER, refund_due_on TEXT, replaces_credit_id INTEGER REFERENCES credit_notes(id))

CREATE TABLE credit_operations(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, credit_note_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES credit_notes(id),
    kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(kind IN ('refund','refund_reversal','offset','offset_reversal')), amount REAL NOT NULL CHECK(amount>0),
    target_invoice_id INTEGER, target_label TEXT DEFAULT '', reverses_id INTEGER UNIQUE REFERENCES credit_operations(id),
    executed_on TEXT, external_ref TEXT DEFAULT '', note TEXT DEFAULT '', created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    CHECK((kind LIKE '%_reversal')=(reverses_id IS NOT NULL)), CHECK(kind<>'offset' OR target_invoice_id IS NOT NULL), CHECK(kind<>'refund' OR executed_on IS NOT NULL))

CREATE TABLE entries(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,work_date TEXT NOT NULL,project_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES projects(id),start_time TEXT DEFAULT '',end_time TEXT DEFAULT '',hours REAL NOT NULL,description TEXT DEFAULT '',source TEXT DEFAULT 'manual',source_ref TEXT DEFAULT '',created_at TEXT DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, import_batch_id TEXT REFERENCES import_batches(id))

CREATE TABLE entry_changes(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, entry_id INTEGER NOT NULL, action TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(action IN ('update','delete')),
    before_json TEXT NOT NULL, after_json TEXT, changed_at TEXT NOT NULL, reason TEXT, actor TEXT, invoices_json TEXT)

CREATE TABLE historical_invoices(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, project_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES projects(id),
    source_file TEXT NOT NULL, source_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', source_sheet TEXT NOT NULL, source_cell TEXT NOT NULL, source_column TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    invoice_date TEXT, invoice_ref TEXT, qty_days REAL, amount_ht REAL, unit_rate REAL,
    basis TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(basis IN ('days','amount','amount_only')), qty_derived INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'proposed' CHECK(status IN ('proposed','validated','rejected')), note TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL, validated_at TEXT, validated_by TEXT,
    CHECK(qty_days IS NOT NULL OR amount_ht IS NOT NULL), CHECK(qty_days IS NULL OR qty_days>0), CHECK(amount_ht IS NULL OR amount_ht>=0),
    CHECK(status<>'validated' OR (validated_at IS NOT NULL AND validated_by IS NOT NULL AND validated_by<>'')),
    CHECK(status<>'rejected' OR note<>''),
    UNIQUE(source_file, source_sheet, source_cell))

CREATE TABLE import_batch_rows(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, batch_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES import_batches(id), source_sheet TEXT NOT NULL, source_row INTEGER NOT NULL, raw_json TEXT NOT NULL, issues TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', decision TEXT NOT NULL, entry_id INTEGER, UNIQUE(batch_id,source_sheet,source_row))

CREATE TABLE import_batches(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, source_filename TEXT NOT NULL, status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('PREPARED','COMMITTED','ROLLED_BACK','FAILED')), source_rows INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, inserted_rows INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, committed_at TEXT, rolled_back_at TEXT, backup_filename TEXT, notes TEXT DEFAULT '', file_sha256 TEXT, backup_sha256 TEXT, error TEXT)
CREATE TABLE invoice_annex_entries(invoice_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES invoices(id), entry_id INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(invoice_id,entry_id))

CREATE TABLE invoice_date_changes(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, invoice_id INTEGER NOT NULL, old_date TEXT, new_date TEXT,
    context TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', changed_at TEXT NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE invoice_lines(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, invoice_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES invoices(id), position INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(position>0),
    kind TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'manual' CHECK(kind='manual'), description TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(trim(description))>0), qty REAL NOT NULL CHECK(qty>0),
    unit TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(unit IN ('day','hour','flat','piece')), unit_rate REAL NOT NULL CHECK(unit_rate>=0), vat_mode TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(vat_mode IN ('soumis','hors_tva')),
    client_uid TEXT, created_at TEXT NOT NULL, UNIQUE(invoice_id,position), UNIQUE(invoice_id,client_uid))

CREATE TABLE invoice_number_changes(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, invoice_id INTEGER NOT NULL, old_number TEXT, new_number TEXT,
    manual INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, context TEXT NOT NULL, changed_at TEXT NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE invoice_snapshots(invoice_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES invoices(id), number TEXT NOT NULL, frozen_at TEXT NOT NULL, frozen_by TEXT NOT NULL, header_json TEXT NOT NULL, annex_json TEXT NOT NULL, pdf BLOB NOT NULL, pdf_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE invoice_variance_decisions(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, invoice_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES invoices(id),
    decision TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(decision IN ('avoir','compensation','aucune')), credit_note_id INTEGER REFERENCES credit_notes(id),
    variance_hours REAL NOT NULL, fingerprint TEXT NOT NULL, reason TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', actor TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', decided_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    CHECK(decision<>'avoir' OR credit_note_id IS NOT NULL))

CREATE TABLE invoices(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,number TEXT UNIQUE,project_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES projects(id),period_from TEXT NOT NULL,period_to TEXT NOT NULL,qty REAL NOT NULL,unit TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'day',unit_rate REAL NOT NULL,vat REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft',issued_at TEXT,note TEXT DEFAULT '',rounding TEXT DEFAULT 'exact',rounding_step REAL DEFAULT 0.25,created_at TEXT DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, description TEXT DEFAULT '', other_amount REAL DEFAULT 0, other_label TEXT DEFAULT '', invoice_date TEXT, reliquat_days REAL, reliquat_treatment TEXT, reliquat_note TEXT DEFAULT '', other_vat_mode TEXT, revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, billing_address_id INTEGER, bill_label TEXT, bill_contact TEXT, bill_address TEXT, number_manual INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0)
CREATE TABLE kept_forms(sid TEXT PRIMARY KEY, path TEXT NOT NULL, data_json TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE login_failures(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, ip TEXT NOT NULL, at TEXT NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE projects(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,name TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,client TEXT DEFAULT '',po TEXT DEFAULT '',rate REAL DEFAULT 0,day_hours REAL DEFAULT 8,vat REAL DEFAULT 0,ordered_days REAL DEFAULT 0,start_date TEXT DEFAULT '',duration_months INTEGER DEFAULT 12,active INTEGER DEFAULT 1, project_number TEXT DEFAULT '', billing_contact TEXT DEFAULT '', billing_address TEXT DEFAULT '', dates_label TEXT DEFAULT '', closed_at TEXT, closed_reason TEXT DEFAULT '', client_legal_name TEXT DEFAULT '', client_legal_id TEXT DEFAULT '', short_name TEXT DEFAULT '')
CREATE TABLE settings(key TEXT PRIMARY KEY, value TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', updated_at TEXT DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
CREATE TABLE web_sessions(sid TEXT PRIMARY KEY, created_at TEXT NOT NULL, last_seen TEXT NOT NULL)
CREATE INDEX idx_annex_entry ON invoice_annex_entries(entry_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_credit_ops_note ON credit_operations(credit_note_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_credit_ops_target ON credit_operations(target_invoice_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_credit_replaces ON credit_notes(replaces_credit_id) WHERE replaces_credit_id IS NOT NULL
CREATE INDEX idx_entries_import_batch ON entries(import_batch_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_entry_changes_entry ON entry_changes(entry_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_historical_project ON historical_invoices(project_id,status)
CREATE INDEX idx_import_rows_entry ON import_batch_rows(entry_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_import_rows_source ON import_batch_rows(source_sheet,source_row)
CREATE INDEX idx_invoice_date_changes ON invoice_date_changes(invoice_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_invoices_number_norm ON invoices(upper(trim(number))) WHERE number IS NOT NULL
CREATE INDEX idx_login_failures ON login_failures(ip, at)
CREATE INDEX idx_number_changes_invoice ON invoice_number_changes(invoice_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_variance_decisions ON invoice_variance_decisions(invoice_id)
